type: Overlock sewing machine (包缝机) panel controller

errorCodes.cause: Main spindle motor stall — machine head stuck or difficult to turn, motor plug or sensor loose/falling off
errorCodes.solution: Check machine head and motor plug. Check motor sensor connector. Check for oil shortage. Check spindle motor drive line for short circuit. Check controller for magnetization. Contact local service or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Main motor software overcurrent — IGBT damaged, motor drive line short circuit, hardware abnormal
errorCodes.solution: Try to restore factory settings or restart power supply. Check IGBT and spindle motor drive line for short. Check electronic control hardware circuit and IGBT/drive chip and surrounding circuits. Replace controller if damaged.

errorCodes.cause: Operation panel and control box communication abnormal — Hall signal connector loose or disconnected
errorCodes.solution: Check operation panel and control box connection cable. If loose/disconnected, restore and restart. Replace controller and contact service if still failing.

errorCodes.cause: Motor Hall error — Hall signal connector loose or foreign body in motor, encoder/positioner plug loose
errorCodes.solution: Turn off power. Check if operation panel and control box cable are loose. Try factory restore or restart. Check M40 value is not 000 or 111. Check handwheel value changes during rotation. Contact service if unresolved.

errorCodes.cause: Needle stop signal abnormal — motor stop signal connector loose or fallen off
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power. Check motor stop signal connector for loose/falling off; restore and restart. Check if fan blade magnets are correctly installed. If position alarm cannot be resolved, the positioning function will auto-disable.

errorCodes.cause: Presser foot protection is on — presser foot not pushed back to correct position
errorCodes.solution: Check if presser foot is pushed back to correct position. For temporary use, change P57 parameter to 0. Check presser foot safety switch sensor for damage. Contact service if unresolved.

errorCodes.cause: Slot protection function is on — sewing table not pushed back to correct position
errorCodes.solution: Check if sewing table is pushed back to correct position. For temporary use, change P58 parameter to 0. Check sewing table safety switch sensor. Contact service if unresolved.

errorCodes.cause: Needle bar shield protection is on — needle bar guard not in correct position
errorCodes.solution: Check that needle bar guard is placed back in correct position. For temporary use, change P59 parameter to 0. Check needle bar shield safety switch sensor. Contact service if unresolved.

errorCodes.cause: Foot pedal connection abnormal — pedal plug not connected or loose
errorCodes.solution: Check if pedal plug is connected to control box or loose. Keep power on and check pedal returns to middle automatically. Check pedal voltage via M05 monitoring or multimeter. Replace pedal if needed.

errorCodes.cause: Main motor hardware overcurrent — IGBT damaged, motor drive lines short circuit
errorCodes.solution: Check if power supply voltage is normal. Try factory restore or power restart. Check IGBT and motor lines. Check electronic control hardware circuits. Replace controller if damaged.

errorCodes.cause: Main motor overpressure during shutdown — supply voltage too high (above 275V)
errorCodes.solution: Check if supply voltage is normal (above 275V is too high). Try factory restore or power restart. Contact local service or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Main motor system undervoltage — supply voltage too low (below 110V)
errorCodes.solution: Check if supply voltage is normal (below 110V is too low). Try factory restore or power restart. Contact local service or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Main motor abnormal brake circuit — brake resistance damaged or abnormal
errorCodes.solution: Contact local service provider or call 4008876858. Check brake resistance value.

errorCodes.cause: Parameter read and write exception
errorCodes.solution: Try to turn off power and restart. Contact local service or call 4008876858 if unresolved.

errorCodes.cause: Main motor current detection loop abnormal — hardware abnormal
errorCodes.solution: Try turning off power and restart. Check hardware, U/V sampling resistors and TVS tube for damage. Check operational amplifier and peripheral components. Contact service if unresolved.

errorCodes.cause: Power off — spindle motor power line out of phase, electronic control hardware drive circuit abnormal
errorCodes.solution: Check spindle motor power line for phase loss. Check electronic control hardware drive circuit. Try turning off power and restart. Contact local service if unresolved.

errorCodes.cause: Spindle motor or IGBT lack of phase — motor power line out of phase, IGBT damaged
errorCodes.solution: Check spindle motor power line. Check hardware: U/V sampling resistors and TVS tube, operational amplifier and peripheral components. Turn off and restart. Contact service if unresolved.

errorCodes.cause: Adapter board communicates abnormally with controller — adapter board connection loose
errorCodes.solution: Check connection between adapter plate and control box for loose. Try factory restore or power restart. Check adapter board connection cable — if loose/falling off/broken, fix it. Replace adapter board if needed.

errorCodes.cause: Factory reset error
errorCodes.solution: After shutdown restart, restore factory settings again.

errorCodes.cause: Foot motor soft overcurrent — IGBT damaged, motor lines short circuit
errorCodes.solution: Check power supply voltage. Try factory restore or restart. Check IGBT and foot motor drive line. Check electronic control hardware circuits and IGBT/drive chip/surroundings. Replace controller if damaged.

errorCodes.cause: Foot motor current detection loop abnormal
errorCodes.solution: Try turning off power and restart. Check hardware: foot motor U/V sampling resistors and TVS tube, operational amplifier and peripheral components. Contact service if unresolved.

errorCodes.cause: Foot motor stall — machine head stuck or difficult to turn, motor plug or encoder connector loose
errorCodes.solution: Check motor plug and encoder connector for loose/falling off/broken. Check foot motor cam position. Contact local service or call 4008875685.

errorCodes.cause: Foot Motor encoder signal abnormal — motor plug or encoder connector loose
errorCodes.solution: Check foot motor power line and encoder line for loose/falling off/broken. Contact service if unresolved.

errorCodes.cause: Foot motor cannot find initial position — motor plug or encoder loose, or cam position incorrect
errorCodes.solution: Check foot motor cam position. Check foot motor power line and encoder line. Replace foot motor or encoder. Contact service.

errorCodes.cause: Foot motor hardware overcurrent
errorCodes.solution: Check power supply. Check IGBT and foot motor drive line. Check hardware circuits. Contact service.

errorCodes.cause: Foot motor overpressure — supply voltage too high (above 275V)
errorCodes.solution: Check supply voltage is normal (above 275V is too high). Try factory restore or restart. Contact service.

errorCodes.cause: Foot motor or IGBT lack of phase
errorCodes.solution: Check foot motor power line for phase loss. Check electronic control hardware drive circuit. Turn off and restart. Contact service.

errorCodes.cause: Foot motor position deviation counter overflowing — encoder grating dusty or damaged, load too high
errorCodes.solution: Check foot motor encoder grating for dust or damage. Check foot pedal encoder interface for loose. Check foot motor drive circuit. Contact service.

errorCodes.cause: Foot motor overspeeding — encoder grating dusty or damaged
errorCodes.solution: Check foot pedal encoder interface for loose. Check foot motor drive circuit. Check foot motor encoder grating for dust/damage. Contact service.

errorCodes.cause: High speed serial communication failure of adapter board — adapter plate connection loose
errorCodes.solution: Check adapter plate and control box connection for loose. Set U94 parameter to 0 or try factory restore. Check adapter board connection cable and replace adapter board if needed.

errorCodes.cause: Counting counts in ascending order full
errorCodes.solution: Press P key to clear, or set P71 parameter to 5.

errorCodes.cause: Counting counts in descending order full
errorCodes.solution: Press P key to clear, or set P71 parameter to 5.

alarmCodes.cause: Front sensor auto calibration failed — sensor surface dirty
alarmCodes.solution: Check receive sensor and transmitter surface — clean if dirty.
Check the sensor receiver and transmitter surface — clean if dirty.
Check the sensor receiver and transmitter surface — clean if dirty.

alarmCodes.cause: Automatic calibration timeout — all three sensor surfaces may be dirty
alarmCodes.solution: Detect all three sensor receiver and transmitter surfaces and clean if dirty.

alarmCodes.cause: Panel and electronic control models do not match
alarmCodes.solution: Upgrade electronic control and panel programs to matching programs.
Apply white grease maintenance as scheduled.
Check connection between panel and acquisition module.
Check if connection between panel and acquisition module is normal.

alarmCodes.cause: Oil free warning — machine is out of oil
alarmCodes.solution: Check oil of sewing machine. Add oil as needed.

alarmCodes.cause: Normal/Thickness switch warning — fabric thickness mode changed
alarmCodes.solution: Normal notification when switching between fabric thickness modes.

checks: Check if machine head is stuck or difficult to turn
Check motor plug and motor sensor connector for loose or fallen off
Check if there is oil shortage — add oil if needed
Check spindle motor drive line and hall signal wire
Call 4008876858 if unable to resolve

troubleshooting.symptom: E3 communication error between panel and control box
checks: Check connection cable between operation panel and control box
Ensure cable is not loose, dropped, or broken
Restore connection and restart system
Replace controller if still failing
Check if presser foot is pushed back to correct position
Set P57 to 0 for temporary bypass if needed
Check presser foot safety switch sensor for damage
This is a normal maintenance reminder
Check oil level of sewing machine
Add oil as required
Clean sensor receiver and transmitter surfaces
Ensure there is no fabric blocking the sensor
Re-run automatic calibration after cleaning

troubleshooting.symptom: Machine speed unexpectedly slow or stops mid-fabric
checks: Check P5 sewing mode — ensure correct mode for fabric type
Check U20 — thick material deceleration may be active
Check fabric type setting P92 matches actual fabric
